register.labelZh: FEEL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: feel for somebody 能幫助你在他人遇到困難時,表達關心和同情。；feel up to something 能幫助你說明自己是否有足夠精神、體力或信心去做某事。；feel somebody up 有助你理解關於未經同意的性騷擾式觸摸的警告、報告和對話。；這些表達看起來相似,但分別談論同情、是否有能力做某事,以及未經同意的性觸摸。
register.summaryEn: Feel for somebody helps you express care when another person is having a difficult time. Feel up to something helps you say whether you are ready, strong enough or confident enough to do it. Feel somebody up is useful for understanding warnings, reports and conversations about unwanted sexual touching. These expressions look similar, but they talk about sympathy, readiness and unwanted touching.
